text: dsh-plugin-terminal 是面向 DSH Web 界面的终端插件，通过 profile bundle 挂载网页底部的交互式终端面板。它提供可切换和调整高度的多标签 shell 会话、工作目录关联、会话重连与重启，并以 xterm.js 显示终端内容。适合需要在 DSH 对话旁运行命令行工具或开发 CLI 的用户。可通过设置快捷键和新会话的 shell 命令调整行为；使用本机 shell 与 PTY，无需额外 API 密钥。

dsh-plugin-terminal adds a multi-tab terminal panel to the DSH Web interface. Run local shell sessions beside conversations, resize the panel, switch tabs, and restore session output after a restart. Configure its shortcut and shell command. It uses xterm.js and needs no API key.
想在 DSH 网页里直接打开命令行终端。
希望在对话页面底部运行本机 shell。
需要同时开几个终端标签并在它们之间切换。
DSH 刷新或重启后，怎样找回之前的终端输出？
想给终端面板设置一个快捷键并调整高度。
I want a shell panel alongside my DSH web conversations.
How can I keep several terminal sessions in tabs in DSH?
I need to restore terminal history after restarting the web server.
dsh-plugin-terminal 的功能「bottom-panel」：提供固定在网页底部的终端面板，可折叠、拖动调整高度，并用快捷键切换显示。
dsh-plugin-terminal 的功能「multi-tab」：支持创建、关闭、重启多个终端标签；切换标签时各自的进程和滚动内容继续保留。
dsh-plugin-terminal 的功能「session-restore」：终端会话信息和输出缓冲区会持久化，重启后可查看退出会话的历史并重新启动。
dsh-plugin-terminal 的功能「workspace-cwd」：新终端会话可使用当前 DSH 工作区目录，并允许重启会话时沿用其目录。
dsh-plugin-terminal 的功能「shell-config」：可从设置项或环境变量指定快捷键和新终端 shell 命令，未指定时采用平台默认 shell。

[中文](README.zh.md) · MIT

dsh-plugin-terminal README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-terminal && dsh web
```

> Note: this is a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin — do **not** use plain `npm i dsh-plugin-terminal`; it must be installed through `dsh plugin` to activate.

dsh-plugin-terminal README · Features：- Bottom panel pinned to the viewport, aligned with the conversation column; the input box always stays above the terminal
- Configurable shortcut toggles (default `Ctrl+``, e.g. `Ctrl+J`); drag the top grip to resize (120px–78% viewport, remembered)
- Multi-tab: `+` new, ✕ close, ⟳ restart; processes keep running on tab switch; live sessions restore after refresh or workspace switch
- Every terminal remembers its working directory: new tabs start in the current DSH workspace; after a `dsh web` restart, ⟳ brings the process back in its original directory instead of the server launch directory
- **Terminals survive dsh web restarts**: session metadata + scrollback are persisted live to `$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/terminal/`; after a restart they come back as "exited" history tabs (full screen replay, one-click restart of the process); tabs you closed stay closed
- xterm.js 6: colors, blinking cursor, alternate screen, Unicode v11 (CJK width tables), 10000-line scrollback
- WebSocket duplex channel to the PTY; dark terminal surface in both light and dark themes
- Copy/paste: select with the mouse and release to copy, right-click to paste; `Ctrl+V` pas

dsh-plugin-terminal README · Configuration：Plugin behavior lives in the DSH settings document (`$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`, section `terminal`), editable from the GUI at **Settings → Plugins**. Changes apply to sessions created afterwards — no restart needed; tabs that already exist keep the command they started with.

dsh-plugin-terminal README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `toggleShortcut` | `ctrl+`` | Keyboard shortcut toggling the bottom panel. Format: `[ctrl|shift|alt|meta]+[...]+key`, e.g. `ctrl+j`, `ctrl+shift+f1`. The key can be a letter, digit, F1–F12, or a name (```, space, enter, tab, up/down/left/right, home/end, pageup/pagedown, delete, backspace, escape). |
| `shellCommand` | *(empty — auto-detect)* | Command line used to start **new** terminal sessions. Empty means the platform default (pwsh/powershell/cmd on Windows, `$SHELL` on POSIX). |

dsh-plugin-terminal README · Configuration：Example — launch cmder on Windows and bind the panel to Ctrl+J:
yaml
terminal:
  toggleShortcut: ctrl+j
  shellCommand: cmd.exe /k "C:\cmder\vendor\init.bat"
```

Notes:

dsh-plugin-terminal README · Configuration：- `shellCommand` is used verbatim (no flags are injected): the command line is split on spaces with double quotes honored, so quoted paths work.
- If the shortcut is a key the terminal also consumes (Ctrl+J is the shell's line feed), a press while a terminal pane has focus goes to the shell instead of toggling the panel.
- Operator override: the environment variables `DSH_PLUGIN_TERMINAL_TOGGLE_SHORTCUT` and `DSH_PLUGIN_TERMINAL_SHELL_COMMAND` take precedence over the settings document (and are the only way to configure headless compositions without the settings service).

dsh-plugin-terminal README · Running codex / claude code in the panel：- Child env gets TERM=xterm-256color and COLORTERM=truecolor (when unset), plus LANG/LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 and PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 on non-Windows, preventing 256-color fallback and CJK mojibake
- xterm.js 6 answers OSC 10/11/12 queries out of the box (Codex theme detection via background-color query just works)
- unicodeVersion "11" keeps mixed CN/EN output aligned; drawBoldTextInBrightColors: false keeps true colors on bold text; CJK fallbacks in the font stack; 10000-line scrollback (500k-char server ring buffer)
section: Running codex / claude code in the panel

text:
dsh-plugin-terminal README · Running codex / claude code in the panel：- **Claude Code**: run /tui fullscreen in the session (or CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1 claude) to switch to the flicker-free fullscreen renderer; /tui default reverts
- **Inside tmux**: make sure TERM=tmux-256color and tmux >= 3.4, add `set -ga terminal-overrides ',xterm-256color:RGB'` if needed
- **Windows mojibake**: use Windows Terminal, chcp 65001, enable the "Beta: Use Unicode UTF-8" system option; fall back to WSL if it persists
- **Update the CLI**: most rendering bugs are regressions already fixed in newer versions
